ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

anyway. So I went down and in the meantime he had got in touch with Norman Sacks and Mel Mandel who had written the music. Mel wrote the book and Norman Sacks wrote the music. So neither one of them knew anything about Maxine Sullivan and they were too young to know. So anyway, Mel said he went out and bought the book The Street That Never Slept. And of course when Arnold Shaw was putting the book together he came up here to the house and interviewed me. In the book are alot of quotes in there, you know, things…
Okay now, "MY Old Friends" was Off- and then Off-Broadway on Off-Broadway at first/and then finally On Broadway at the 22 Steps Theater.
